mapper.select: WITH today_stats AS ( -- 今日数据统计（订单数包含所有状态，营业额仅含有效订单） SELECT mb.merchant_base_id, mb.merchant_name AS merchantName, COUNT(DISTINCT om.order_main_id) AS todayOrderCount, -- 所有订单（含取消/退款） -- 营业额：仅统计已支付且未取消的订单 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN om.pay_status = 1 AND om.order_status != 5 THEN om.total_amount END)/(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN om.order_status != 5 THEN om.order_main_id END)*2), 0) AS todayRevenue, -- 各状态订单数（包含所有支付状态） COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN om.order_status = 1 THEN om.order_main_id END) AS pendingCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN om.order_status = 2 THEN om.order_main_id END) AS waitingDeliveryCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN om.order_status = 3 THEN om.order_main_id END) AS deliveringCount FROM merchant_base mb LEFT JOIN order_takeout_detail otd ON mb.merchant_base_id = otd.merchant_id LEFT JOIN order_main om ON otd.order_main_id = om.order_main_id AND om.order_type = 1 -- 外卖订单 AND DATE(om.create_time) = CURDATE() -- 今日订单 WHERE mb.merchant_base_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY mb.merchant_base_id, mb.merchant_name ), yesterday_stats AS ( -- 昨日数据统计 SELECT mb.merchant_base_id, COUNT(DISTINCT om.order_main_id) AS yesterdayOrderCount, -- 所有订单（含取消/退款） -- 营业额：仅统计已支付且未取消的订单 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN om.pay_status = 1 AND om.order_status != 5 THEN om.pay_amount END), 0) AS yesterdayRevenue FROM merchant_base mb LEFT JOIN order_takeout_detail otd ON mb.merchant_base_id = otd.merchant_id LEFT JOIN order_main om ON otd.order_main_id = om.order_main_id AND om.order_type = 1 -- 外卖订单 AND DATE(om.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) -- 昨日订单 WHERE mb.merchant_base_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY mb.merchant_base_id ), total_stats AS ( -- 总数据统计 SELECT mb.merchant_base_id, COUNT(DISTINCT om.order_main_id) AS orderCount, -- 所有订单（含取消/退款） -- 营业额：仅统计已支付且未取消的订单 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN om.pay_status = 1 AND om.order_status != 5 THEN om.pay_amount END), 0) AS revenue FROM merchant_base mb LEFT JOIN order_takeout_detail otd ON mb.merchant_base_id = otd.merchant_id LEFT JOIN order_main om ON otd.order_main_id = om.order_main_id AND om.order_type = 1 -- 外卖订单 WHERE mb.merchant_base_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY mb.merchant_base_id ) SELECT ts.merchantName, ts.todayOrderCount, ts.todayRevenue, ts.pendingCount, ts.waitingDeliveryCount, ts.deliveringCount, -- 计算与昨日对比的百分比变化 CASE WHEN ys.yesterdayOrderCount = 0 AND ts.todayOrderCount > 0 THEN 100.00 WHEN ys.yesterdayOrderCount = 0 AND ts.todayOrderCount = 0 THEN 0.00 ELSE ROUND(((ts.todayOrderCount - ys.yesterdayOrderCount) / ys.yesterdayOrderCount) * 100, 2) END AS orderCountChangePercent, CASE WHEN ys.yesterdayRevenue = 0 AND ts.todayRevenue > 0 THEN 100.00 WHEN ys.yesterdayRevenue = 0 AND ts.todayRevenue = 0 THEN 0.00 ELSE ROUND(((ts.todayRevenue - ys.yesterdayRevenue) / ys.yesterdayRevenue) * 100, 2) END AS revenueChangePercent, -- 总数据 tot.orderCount, tot.revenue FROM today_stats ts LEFT JOIN yesterday_stats ys ON ts.merchant_base_id = ys.merchant_base_id LEFT JOIN total_stats tot ON ts.merchant_base_id = tot.merchant_base_id
